This has always been the functionality. The point of anonymizing posts is to separate OP's identity from the post. This is done most simply by changing the status of the post to anon. All that does is change OP's username under the title to anon, and make all subsequent comments anon. Had OP not also opted to anonymize his comments upon account deletion, his comments in the thread would have remained non-anon.
